Name: Phase1 Safe Auto-Remediation Operator
Description: Least-privilege role for the Phase 1 auto-remediation Managed Identity. Grants only the read/write actions the in-scope Fix-*.ps1 scripts need (Storage, Key Vault, Function/Web App, Defender pricing) plus tag write for evidence tagging and read access to resolve subscription Environment/Criticality tags. Deliberately excludes Contributor, RBAC-assignment actions (Microsoft.Authorization/*), and delete permissions on anything.
